name: dsfd_wfc_vmx_r-p1-COMMIT
purpose: S81 sp_wfc priced kit: the VM -> WFC outbound prefetch / DONE half of dsfd_wfc_vmx as its own leaf. Response pin flops (1,026 b), prefetch control, 64 x 1032 response queue in 5 x ot_sram_1r1w_128x256, read-request skid + grant link, slow -> fast ratio FIFO, the staging buffer in 2 x ot_sram_1r1w_64x512 (even / odd words) behind a registered look-ahead (was 64 x 512 flops and a 64:1 x 512 mux), predicted read register at the pin, DONE. Two related clocks (as dsfd_wfc_vmx_w). 0 cycles added: cycle-exact with the one-tile kit in the cluster lockstep bench.
